# NDI SDK headers

These headers are vendored from the official NDI SDK 6.3.2.0 (`Include/`).
They are used only to build the dynamically loaded NDI API adapter. The NDI
runtime itself is not bundled or redistributed by this repository; users who
want NDI input install the NDI Runtime separately.

The header files state that the MIT license applies to each file only, not to
the SDK as a whole. The copyright and MIT permission notice is retained in each
header. See <https://ndi.video/> and <https://ndi.link/ndisdk_license> for the
SDK and runtime terms.
